first.rationale: Competitive entry pricing creates an immediate acquisition risk among price-sensitive SMBs, and prior evidence indicates targeted promotional pricing can lift qualified acquisition and revenue. Verify both the pricing evidence and onboarding evidence before committing because activation and onboarding have also deteriorated. Any pricing test should be segmented and assessed for retention, expansion, and discount-driven revenue quality rather than top-line conversion alone.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified onboarding result improved completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing the current declines in onboarding completion and activation while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Do not use promotional pricing: its verified 30-day retention decline of 12% makes its short-term qualified-revenue lift unsuitable for the primary objective. Measure activation, qualified conversion, and retention by cohort to confirm the historical result holds in the current environment.
